name: claude-stats
description: Usage limits (5h / 7d) and ccusage spend, drawn as a status band above the prompt.

showSpend.title: Show spend
showSpend.description: Show the session cost and ccusage's today / month spend. Off: only the usage limits are drawn and ccusage never runs.

ccusageCommand.title: ccusage command
ccusageCommand.description: How to run ccusage. Tried directly first, then through your login shell (so nvm/volta PATHs work in the desktop app).

refreshSeconds.title: ccusage refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: Minimum time between ccusage runs. ccusage rescans your session logs on every run.
